name: Total Volumes Of Exotics
query_sql:
SELECT
    SUM(daily_volume) FILTER (WHERE category = 'Exotics') AS total_exotics_vol,
    SUM(daily_volume) FILTER (WHERE category = 'Sports') AS total_sports_vol,
    SUM(daily_volume) AS total_kalshi_vol,
    100.0 * SUM(daily_volume) FILTER (WHERE category = 'Exotics') / NULLIF(SUM(daily_volume), 0) AS total_exotics_pct
FROM kalshi.market_report
